title: Hoshino Ichika — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What a nice breeze...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The flowers are swaying like they're enjoying it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, there you are, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't find you in the classroom, so I was wondering where you'd gone to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah! Hold it, Saki! Stop where you are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Um, okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry for raising my voice all of a sudden.
It's just, there's a flower over there, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right! I didn't notice it at all.
Thanks for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I almost didn't manage to avoid it... Wait!
I stepped on a little bit of the leaves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going to happen now?
Will this flower wither and die?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Ah, this shouldn't be a problem.
This species of flower is pretty tough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Phew... What a relief.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, why am I not surprised that you know so much about flowers?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know about it because it's a common flower, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But it's not just this flower.
You also know a lot about many other flowers too, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember you used to teach me many things about them,

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes... I did, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yep! When I was in the hospital, or bedridden at home, you'd always come visit with flowers and then tell me many different things about them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, that sure brings back memories.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't get anything grand, so I would pick just one after looking up its symbolism.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, going to the florist was so fun. I was still in elementary school then, so the shop staff would sometimes give me a discount.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so sure it was because of your flowers that I was able to recover and get discharged!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come on, Saki... That's an exaggeration.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, I've been pressing those flowers you gave me and keeping them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whenever things get tough, I'd look at those flowers and it's like all my bad feelings get sucked away, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, speaking of which, I remember you once brought a morning glory that you'd planted in school too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. And I had no idea it was unlucky to visit someone with a potted flower, which was exactly what I had brought...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can still clearly remember the shocked look on the nurse's face back then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we also planted a morning glory flower bed in the garden at my home, along with Shiho and Hona, using the seeds from that flower, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. All of us went to your house to do that, and we also went back to check on the flowers too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! But because I didn't manage to water the flowers for about a week...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It can't be helped since you weren't feeling well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the morning glories became all droopy because of that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were really depressed about it, so the three of us tried our best to take care of the flowers on our own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was so surprised to see them doing so well when I went out to the garden one day after a long time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I asked mom about it, and she told me the three of you had been taking care of them. I was so touched I broke into tears right there in the garden!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, it's a precious memory of mine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Will we be able to play together like that again someday?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know! We just have to try, right?
Maybe we should talk to Hona and Shiho after school today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's try that.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Lunch break will be over in fifteen minutes?
Time passes so quickly whenever I'm listening to Miku's songs.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's good to finally meet you in person, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope I can see that Miku again—)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, what're you listening to?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki... And Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She always goes to the rooftop to take her lunch break. It's unusual to see her in the classroom at this time.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry for interrupting you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm always listening to these songs, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means you're listening to Miku's songs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, I am?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So the thing is, Haruka here's kinda curious about Miku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I recently met Miku—I mean, watched some of her videos, and got a little bit curious about her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I was talking about it with Tenma, she let me know that you're very familiar with Miku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, if you don't mind, could you tell me more about her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, sure. I don't mind at all.
What videos did you watch?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The genre is idol songs.
She was singing on this really large stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was almost as if she was really there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So a song from one of her virtual shows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's quite a well-known song.
Let me find it for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you also attend these virtual shows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And does she start talking to you like a real pers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Uh, nevermind.
Are there any other songs of hers that you would recommend?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have lots.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For idol songs, you can try this...and also this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, what an adorable song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She does cover songs too.
This one's pretty popular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ah, I know the original version of this song.
Hehe, it feels completely different when Miku sings it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's also this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Miku can sing like this too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, sorry. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for your help. This will be very useful.
Let me know again if you have any other recommendations, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think that helped with her problem?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki? Did something happen to Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I'm not sure, but she seemed troubled about something, so I went up to talk to her, and the topic just drifted to Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So I thought, maybe she wouldn't feel so troubled anymore if you could tell her more about Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's why you brought her to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I just hope she got the help she needed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be fine. If you sense that she's feeling troubled again, we'll go talk to her together, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay. Also, something's been bothering me...
Did you hear Haruka say she recently met Miku, then corrected herself?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes... I was wondering about that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think it's possible that she did meet Miku, the same way we did?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Surely not...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway. I wanna listen to the songs that Haruka was listening to just now too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, got it. Give me a minute.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Classes are really dragging on today...
We finally have a band going, so I'd rather be practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (English class is so boring...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have a question!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Could you tell me what this word here means?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It depends on the context. Here it would be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I get it now!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She seems to be genuinely enjoying the lesson.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish I could have as much fun at school as Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But it's not like wishing for it will change anything. It only makes me feel more frustrated.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe I should express my feelings through a song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll give it a try.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Great! I finally caught up with the rest of the class!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can go to our rehearsal with a clear conscience today, without feeling bad about having fun when I should be studying... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi's furiously writing something in her notebook. She seemed to be spacing out until just a moment ago?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But it doesn't look like she's copying from the blackboard.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Is she doodling?
Nah, she's too focused on whatever it is.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hmm, I think I know what she's up to!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, class. That's it for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Alright... I got the rough idea down on paper.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Now it just needs some polishing.
I'll have to think of words which express my feelings more accurately.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hah, I knew it! You were writing song lyrics!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! What on earth, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I saw you scribbling something in class, and you had this focused look in your eyes, so I guessed it was a song you were writing. Teehee, bingo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Show me what you wrote!
What is it about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can read it but... Don't laugh, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What have we got here... The unbearable ennui of English?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, don't read it out loud!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Clock hands, don't be sluggish, make it finish... Aah, I see you went for a rhyme there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's enough!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, don't hide your notes! I'm not done reading!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not my problem! You've seen enough!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why are you being like that? We might perform this song with our band one day. Who knows. Don't be shy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Forget it! This is just a draft.
I'll show you the finished version once it's ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So just drop it for now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Have it your way...
Don't keep me waiting too long for the good-to-go version!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know what...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Curiosity's killing me right now! I HAVE to read it! Gimme!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hands off it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Where were we? Gazing out the window with melancholy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not out loud, Saki!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
School was great today!
I can't wait for tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really like school, you weirdo.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's not to like about spending the day with my friends!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice that we're all going to the same school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I missed it so much, I'm just loving every day of it♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess I'm having more fun too now that you're back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we can always talk about band stuff, and ask for advice with anything that didn't go so well when rehearsing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh? Ichika, are you having some problems you want to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not at the moment, but there's something else I've been thinking about...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, is there any way we can practice without our instruments?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sometimes I want to go over a song when I have some time before a class, but obviously I don't have my guitar with me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I often imagine playing while listening to songs. Other than that, I do finger exercises.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You do what?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She practices the finger movements for playing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, that rings a bell, actually! I had to do that for my piano lessons too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember seeing this scene in my dad's band manga where one artist was using a packet of cigarettes to exercise his fingers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Using a small box can work, but not a cig box.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That'd get us in trouble at school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As long as it's about the same width as a guitar fret, any box is fine for that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see if we can find one for Ichi, so that she can practice with it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What, now? People may have other stuff to do, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm free. I was just going to go back home after school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same, I don't have work today. Besides, I know how frustrating it is when you want to practice so bad but don't have the kit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, guys.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... We've been to the convenience store, and the drugstore...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we picked up some boxes from the discount store, too. I think we have a pretty good assortment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Pick the box you think's the best from your haul! Mine's this, a fancy chocolate bar box!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mine's the bandage box.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The gummies box for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Everyone went for something different.
I think this candy box is best.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why don't we have Ichika try all of them out?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, except Saki's.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Why's mine no good?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The thickness is okay, but it's too wide.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I think mine will be too thick.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: None of the boxes is just right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The one I picked isn't perfect either.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mine's about the same size as yours.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case we have no choice but to resort to...DIY!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are we going to...build a box?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You said the chocolate box was the right thickness, but it was too wide, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So we just need to cut it to the right size!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you mean like doing it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: DIY!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, if you want to call it that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think she just likes the sound of it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's go to my house!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can share this chocolate bar, and then we use the empty box to make a tool for Ichi to practice her fingering!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, okay. Thank you for doing this for me.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, are you sure you've recovered from your cold?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course I have! My fever's gone down already, and I even rested for longer than usual just in case. I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. But don't ever overwork yourself like that again. After all, we're finally in a band together with Shiho now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I know that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really so glad that we found out why Shiho had been keeping her distance all this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What's this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm just grateful because you made all this happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Coming back to school, saying you wanted to form a band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I was the one to bring it up, yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if you hadn't agreed to it in the first place, we wouldn't even be here talking about being in a band with Shiho at all, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... I didn't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You absolutely helped!
So thank you from me too, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to start a band together with me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah... You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's...kind of embarrassing to be thanked so directly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, look at that, Ichi! It's Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That music video is the same one I saw on the day I had that dream...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When you look at Miku in our world here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It makes that SEKAI place we went to seem even more mysterious, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. That place is certainly full of mysteries.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The song Untitled appeared in our smartphones suddenly, and playing or stopping the song allows us to travel to and back from that world freely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Then we got to meet Miku and Luka there, and they're even in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then if we find our true feelings, those feelings may give birth to a song or something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Miku did say that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can you believe we were just having band practice there together with Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I definitely never imagined a high school life like this when I was still in the hospital!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Who would?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Back then, I could only watch Miku and think about how amazing it was that she could sing anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But... I feel like things are different now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki?
Why the sudden smirk?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you were smiling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? But it's not like I never smile or anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, but it's not about the smile.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You seem to be really happy about something, that's why.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I used to not have anything I wanted to do or work hard for. Days rolled by without much purpose for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But now...I want to help Saki do what she wants.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And then maybe one day, even Honami will...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, the signal turned green. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It must be because of Saki, Miku, and Luka that things are starting to be put into motion.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Is there anything I can do too?
For Saki, Shiho, and Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't think of anything right now, except...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll be giving my all to the band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, that's what I'll be doing too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. So this is where Ichi works, then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but...are we really going to do this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After we've already tailed her all the way here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You have a point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What are we waiting for? Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... Everyone, thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, are you tired?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, today was actually pretty tiring...
Or should I say, surprising.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I saw you three coming over with those smug grins on your faces when I took over the cash register...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry for not telling you in advance.
We decided to make it a surprise visit after some discussion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I've always wanted to see what your workplace looked like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just so hard to imagine you serving customers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And when we tried to order a smile to go along with, you completely ignored us too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Nobody makes an order like that anymore these days...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I really wanted a smile from you!
Pretty please with a cherry on top?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't take orders outside working hours.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's put all of that aside and go meet Miku and Luka like we promised, okay?
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, Miku and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, all of you came together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Oh, and there's something we'd like you to know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've decided to continue playing in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We already have a name for our band too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Fantastic! What's your band name then?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's Leo/need.
We based it on the Leonids meteor shower that we saw together in the past.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What a lovely name.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. It's very cool!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But why is there a slash in the middle?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's because...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I fully intend to give this band my all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to make lots of great memories with everyone and enjoy our time in high school together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Super! You have my full support.

rows.Speaker: Miku

rows.Line: Oh... I do remember that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also remember my Mom being so mad at me for ruining it like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, but if you remember that,
maybe you remember that other time too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... What other time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... You know, that time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh... I need a hint!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... It was another time you did something completely unexpected, like using your textbook as an umbrella...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Uh, on second thought...
I'm not sure I actually want to know now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Now you're making me want to say it instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehe!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was a great practice session, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We've gotten a lot better at playing this song too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have. And we should be able to do the whole thing tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let's pack up and make sure we don't leave anything behind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot...
Did you change the way you drum, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your rhythm was impeccable as usual, but also...
It was easier to follow than before, maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, I thought the same thing too!
It's has a different sort of aura to it now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Like you know exactly what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I felt the same way too. I could really tell that you were enjoying yourself a lot more, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well... Now that the choir recital is all done,
maybe I feel lighter and more free?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that's not the only thing, is it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. The effort you put in towards being able to talk to your classmates more honestly must have helped too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That experience probably gave you a confidence boost, and improved your sound as a result.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I really hope that's true!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure it is.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Confidence, huh...? Maybe I'll get the same boost if I try to overcome something I'm having trouble with too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then let's actually try it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We will now start Operation Talent Boost to improve how Ichi plays by helping her to overcome something she's having trouble with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Why are you so excited about this, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I'm helping my dearest childhood friend♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that all...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Well, as long as Saki's having fun...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright. What are some things Ichi's having trouble with?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It has to be thrill rides or roller coasters. She was so scared that one time we went to Phoenix Wonderland and went on those rides when we were kids.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I remember that! That really brings back memories!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So if she overcomes her fears, we'll be able to go on lots of roller coaster rides... Wait, that's not the point...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's supposed to get a confidence boost and get better at playing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure this will...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me see...
Overcoming a fear of roller coasters... Search!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you doing, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm trying to find articles that contain tips on overcoming a fear of roller coasters... Oh, here's one! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Try to imagine how exciting the scenery will be, like the wind in your face or the sense of liberation you can get from screaming loudly...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... I clung to the safety bar like my life depended on it last time and was too scared to even look up, so that might tough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but what if...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're all kidnapped by some shady organization and you can't save us unless you overcome your fear of roller coasters!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Where did you get that story from?
It sounds like pure fantasy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww... I thought it was a pretty good idea...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Wait! I just thought of a much easier way for you to overcome something you're having trouble with.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See, right here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? This place's menu...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Your rice omelet is here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that smells so nice! And it looks delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's making me hungry too.
But not Ichika from the looks of it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because the rice underneath this omelet is full of green peas, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I just can't stand green peas...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're trying to overcome something you're having trouble with, remember? If you'd rather do the roller coaster challenge, we'd be all for that too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ugh... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, Ichi! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You two just want to have fun at my expense...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Anyway, here's your spoon...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Fine. I'll eat it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Found them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You shouldn't be looking for them!
Just eat normally!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
More like they were looking for me.
They stand out from the rice's ketchupy color...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'll feed you so you don't have to look at them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, thank you... I have a feeling you'll put way more green peas than is necessary into my mouth...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aww... You're good, Ichi.
You saw right through me!
Then... Let's have Hona feed you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, Honami wouldn't do anything funny so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, allow me to do the honors.
Ichika, open wide...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Ugh... This texture...
And the taste they leave behind...
They're there... I'm eating them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why are you savoring it when you hate them so much?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, have some water.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Honami! Gulp...
Sigh... I was so sure I was going to die...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: From green peas?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is gonna take a while, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then why don't we share it instead?
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's stop here for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... Great work...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Finally... Back to back days of this is so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: On the other hand, you've all been getting so much better. You can really tell just by listening!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You in particular, Ichika. Your singing's improved dramatically, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... It has?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup, she's right♪ When I hear you sing, Ichi, it gets me all fired up and motivated to play even better!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! You say you're tired, but it still sounds like you're ready for more!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But make sure not to overdo it, okay? It's important to take breaks too, especially since you're all in such a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Taking a break...
It is almost spring so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The cherry blossoms are all blooming, so we should go see them together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds lovely!
I'll bring the food if we do go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
R-Really?! You hear that, Ichi, Shiho?!
Not only are we gonna get to see some beautiful cherry blossoms together, we get to eat Hona's delicious cooking while we do!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We heard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The ones from that park were in full bloom too. I can't wait...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about you, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's been spending all of her time working with us and helping us improve. It feels like she hardly has any personal time anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Shiho!
We only have morning practice that day, so we can go then!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki...
The weather forecast said that it might rain then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Rain? Then how about next week...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, we'll be fine♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we do this, Shiho? If it isn't raining that day, we go see the cherry blossoms right after practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, that works.
Oh, but don't blame me if it starts raining.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I won't! But promise me too, okay♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I talked to Miku and Luka about this too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you wanna come see them with us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
Hehe. All of us together♪
It's gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it should be.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhum♪
Cherry blossoms, cherry blossoms♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Say, Saki...
Are you sure about only going to see them if it isn't raining...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really could rain, so we could've just moved it back until next week, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That may be true, but what if they're all gone by then? If we're gonna go see them, why not while they're in full bloom?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we'll definitely be able to go! I even know the perfect way to make sure it'll be sunny♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The perfect way?
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many pieces of cloth... What do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: These are all leftovers from when Tsukasa made costumes and props and stuff! Aren't they great? They're so shiny and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true, but what does this have to do with making sure it'll be sunny...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... First, we take one of the white pieces of cloth, round it up into a ball...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Take one of the sparkly cloths to cover it up and...! Ta-da! Your very own lucky weather charm♪ You can even tie a cute, little ribbon onto it too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, don't tell me you forgot?
The four of us made these in elementary school to make sure it'd be sunny for an outing we really wanted to go on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So as long as we all make them, it'll be sunny for sure!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So here...!
Your turn, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, is this any different from just praying for good weather?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
These mean way more than just some words and they physically represent our wishes!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I guess that's a nicer way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But rain or shine, how will things turn out...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What does Shiho actually want to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, which cloths do you want to use?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'll try the sparkly blue one.
It's like the night sky in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good choice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also have a bunch of buttons that we can use as eyes too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm not really sure what Shiho wants to do or how things will turn out, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I do want to go see those cherry blossoms with everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's to hoping for a sunny day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!
The day of the cherry blossom picnic
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We actually got good weather...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Did our weather charms really work...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahh... It's so sunny!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How many times are you going to say that, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's past twenty already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! No I haven't...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Shall we start getting everything ready then?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lunch, snacks, juice... All set♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, all that's left is...
Thanks for waiting, Miku, Luka, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Don't mind us. We've just been chatting the whole time.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If anything, we should be the ones thanking you for inviting us.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that you guys could come along to see the cherry blossoms with us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh... Luka, MEIKO, look!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wow! They really are in full bloom...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, they're so beautiful.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get our cherry blossom viewing picnic started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, then everyone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki & Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Hona, this is amazing!
Fried chicken, omelets and bite-size Salisbury steaks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It really is! It's almost like it could be in a recipe book!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was really looking forward to today, so I spent yesterday making everything I could.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mmm... These Salisbury steaks are so good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I made plenty so have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I made some rice balls too if anyone would like some...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh oh... They've sort of lost their original shape and turned into balls...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did have to carry everything over here, but I'm sure they're still okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I probably should've wrapped them up a little tighter.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I think they look cuter this way!
Mind passing me one, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hnng...!!
I-It's so sour!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You got one with an umeboshi in it.
How about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, if she also gets one of these, we get to see her sour face!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, I got a salmon one.
Honami, can I have another Salisbury steak?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Go right ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How many have you had already, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not sure. I just don't want to miss out on these.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair!
I'm not gonna let you hog them all, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's still plenty more where that came from, Saki. Here's one for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They look like they're having fun.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They do! And thank goodness it didn't rain either!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Let's keep watching over them.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, the cherry blossoms...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they're so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me... Didn't we used to play a game to see who could catch the most petals?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! Wow, talk about a blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, wanna try doing that now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we just finished eating...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, now we need to work it off!
Everyone, stand up! You too, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Then how about the first to catch one is the winner? Also, we're allowed to play defense.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That sounds wonderful! Have fun, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, would you mind being the starter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sure. On your marks...
Get set... Go!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No! It slipped through my fingers...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There! You're mine...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Saki...?!
Are you blowing them away from us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Shiho said we could do this, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hwah! Hiho?! What are you yooing?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This counts as defense too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo, nawt my heeks...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was a little worried about the weather and how things would turn out, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to do this.
The day of the STANDOUT show
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have to tell Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All of us froze up when she asked us that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But now I know. We know...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I need to go...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, over here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're both early.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You too, Ichika.
We still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True, but I couldn't just sit around at home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't stay still and wait knowing that we have to tell Shiho how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They're both smiling, but probably feel just as nervous as I do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I suppose we should. We're about to unleash a flood of emotions in terms of how we truly feel on her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you both ready...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You, Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've kept her waiting long enough...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope she'll hear us out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, but...
What if she's already decided to leave Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We still have to tell her.
She needs to know how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You're right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's go find Shiho!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The show's up this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! We should hurry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can we table that idea for now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have a dream...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to go pro and play music that can touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a part of me that was hoping we'd all be able to pursue that dream together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But not all of you want to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho's always been serious about that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's always wanted to play for people and find a way to touch their hearts, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, there's no way I can ever be that good. There are just so many great musicians out there too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Even if it's not entirely possible for me to become one, I can at least help her get close to the level she wants to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never actually thought that I could. I kept admiring from afar without actually trying.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That mindset is what kept hurting Shiho...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That lack of resolve kept her waiting...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hey! That looks like the venue!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Now, I... No, we...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We have to tell her how we feel now...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Please, Shiho, we beg you...!
Just wait a little longer...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Give us a chance to tell you!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Excuse me. Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Ichika! Are you here to see Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up? Did you forget your textbook or something?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm actually here to see you, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh... I knew you and Minori were sort of close, but I didn't know you knew Kohane too, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know her from doing street performances...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I told you about playing in public to get better at singing, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At first, I couldn't sing or play anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when I saw Kohane doing her own street performance and asked her for some help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then you're just like me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In the beginning, I made a lot of mistakes, had equipment issues and felt like nothing was ever going to go well.

rows.Line: But my teammates all came together and told me that they believe in me.
