rows.Line: Whoa! I'm so fired up now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I think that should be enough for now in terms of tickets.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good!
Shall we go practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami, Shiho. Over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona! Shiho! Come on in♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's been getting so cold in the corridor lately.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. It's also cloudy today, so not many people seem to be having lunch out in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Days like these are all about eating together in a nice, cozy classroom.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Oh, Ichika, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The CD by that artist you like went on sale yesterday, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it did...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? You had to stay late to take care of some class representative business yesterday, right? Did you miss your chance to get it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I got a copy.
But only because someone else let me have theirs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They let you have their copy?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. There was one copy left at the store I went to, but another person was there to buy the same CD...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And they ended up giving me their copy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I feel awful about what happened.
They must've really been looking forward to listening to it too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are there any plans for a re-release?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not that I know of.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what if they managed to get a copy at a different store?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I sure hope so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: However, only a few stores were carrying this CD. The one I went to was the closest one around here, so they would've had to go down another station if they were to do that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yikes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to bring down the mood like that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I was the one who asked. You don't need to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She must've been looking forward to it too...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, Ichi!
What if we tried finding this person?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This morning, you said this person's around our age and how they might be a fan of Miku songs, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, because being a fan of this artist probably means that they're also a fan of Miku songs...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's why I'm betting you'd be able to become friends with them♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: F-Friends?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree with Saki. I'm sure you two would hit it off great if she does turn out to be another Miku fan like you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
See?
We should find this person so you can lend them your CD...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
H-Hold on one second, Saki.
How do we actually find them...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How? Well...
What if you ran a stakeout on the CD shop?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A stakeout...?
That's easier said than done.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if they're around our age, they could be a student at one of the other schools.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, yeah!
What was this person wearing, Ichi?
If they were wearing a uniform...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, um... They were wearing sweats...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sweats? From where?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They didn't look School Issue or anything. I think they were just regular sweats.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Darn. That would've made things so much easier.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way... Was this person a boy? A girl?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A girl with beautiful, long hair.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Sweats and beautiful, long hair?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, it can't be.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what if we asked around online about this person?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like... <I'm looking for the person who gave me this CD yesterday!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I'd really rather not blow things out of proportion like that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, someone could see that as an opportunity to be a total jerk about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, thanks for taking this so seriously and putting so much thought into it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll ever see her again, but I'll try going back to the CD shop when I have time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If they do like Miku songs, I might be able to find them there on days when new Miku CDs go on sale.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. And if they're a high schooler like us, you might just bump into them after school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It'd be like a miracle... No, fate!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. Hear that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Quit exaggerating, you two.
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... I've made some good progress today in terms of learning more about songwriting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I can only do this on days when I'm not assigned much homework.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, this seems like a good place to take a break. I think I'll put on a Miku song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... I haven't had a chance to listen to Yoisaki's other songs yet. Maybe I should put one of those on instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Oh wow. Marionette has so many views.
I guess I can start with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It has such a unique sound and some dark overtones to it, but the intro's so catchy.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The lyrics don't pull any punches either...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's like this song puts everything out in the open without hesitation...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: One more time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The phrasing, or the metaphors being used, I guess...? I can tell exactly what this song's trying to say...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And Asahina's the one who wrote these lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's so kind and thoughtful, so I never would've imagined her being able to write such dark lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Or is it just a testament to her creativity?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Either way, she's an incredible person...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I need to keep doing everything I can to be able to clearly express how I feel through what I write.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina, good morning...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Hoshino.
You're here quite early. Morning practice? No, that can't be it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I woke up earlier than usual, so I'm going to head to my class to work on some lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You've been hard at work, I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I haven't been making much progress...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but I did get to listen to one of your group's songs yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You did? Thank you.
Would you mind telling me your thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course! Um, I listened to Marionette, the one about the puppet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was completely blown away by the phrasing and metaphors used in the lyrics...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the lyrics were really able to bring the song to life because a puppet was at the center of it all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to ramble on like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I appreciate it. I'm the one who asked for your thoughts, and I'm glad you liked it so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I asked you a little about how you came up with those lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure, what would you like to know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About the song's interludes and bridge after each chorus when the listener seems to be asked, “Right?” or “Don't you get it?”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're not actually a part of the lyrics, are they? How did you arrive on doing that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry to disappoint you, but there's really nothing to those parts...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? I-Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I was told that it would sound a little creepier if I were to add in something like what you heard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ultimately, its purpose became to add some spice to the voids left after each chorus sequence...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They hold no real meaning in terms of the lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay, I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was so sure that there was some deeper meaning to those parts. I feel so embarrassed about overthinking things like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, don't be. I should be apologizing for misdirecting you in such a manner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I really appreciate how you took what I wrote so seriously.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And everybody who listens to that song is perfectly entitled to their own interpretations.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you seem to use a lot of metaphors in your lyrics. Is there a reason behind that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm... It's usually because I can't find the right words to describe something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Or when I'm being deliberately vague.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, deliberately vague...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes. For example...
“Anger” comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I may be mad at someone, Person A, for some reason, but those who aren't familiar with Person A won't understand how I feel even if I try to write lyrics about them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And it'd be rude to call them out by name, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's when I'll use words like “bully” or “braggart” instead.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then it becomes clear who's playing which role in this situation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that makes so much sense...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's also important to use different euphemisms or examples depending on how a particular song goes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “Braggart”, for example, may be more suited to a song with a brighter or upbeat tone to it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Conversely, referring to people as chess pieces, such as a queen or king, could work if you wish to treat them like an opponent for a dark song with a sharper tone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to sound so snobbish. I know I'm not a professional or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, everything you just said makes so much sense! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll be sure to keep your advice in mind when writing lyrics from now on!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad I could help.
Good luck, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning, Hoshino, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's get right to it, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right to what...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Leo/need's going to be participating in a show soon, and we were wondering if you'd like to come see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you for the invitation.
Do you know when you'll be playing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it should be on the ticket...
Ah, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Perfect.
We only have practice that day, I should be able to go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! That means Minori can also...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: I can gooo!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, for sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I guess Shiho was in the middle of inviting her classmates to our show♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since Hinomori's already talking to them, I guess I can go ahead and reserve my own ticket now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't need to thank me. I've been meaning to see your band perform, and I'm sure you have a quota to meet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Haruka, you know about ticket quotas?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember talking to bands on this one music show about having to sell their own tickets when they were just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Feel free to ask if you ever have any left over. I know some people who love going to these kinds of shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much! We're just starting out as well, so we'll appreciate any help we can get.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. There is some fun in having to sell things yourself, but having to do that on top of practicing for shows can be tough at times.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean you've had to do this before, Kiritani...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was CDs instead of tickets in my case.
When ASRUN made its debut, we had to sell CDs at malls and such all by ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! There was a time when ASRUN had to do that? I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, me neither.
I always thought ASRUN was famous from the start.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well, you're not far off.
Our debut single just happened to become a hit, which sent us soaring up the charts.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I still vividly remember all the shows we did at those malls...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You do...?
What were they like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was so nervous at first that I stuttered while introducing myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But singing made everything more fun and enjoyable. Before we knew it, we'd somehow attracted an audience.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I became so elated that I couldn't stop singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing your music have an effect on someone really is the best feeling in the world.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's so encouraging too.
I always feel like singing even more whenever that happens.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it's that exact feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know how that feels too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whenever I see people in the crowd really getting into our music, I can't help but want to make it even more fun for them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And if people we personally sold tickets to are in the audience...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It'd be even more amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess that does make selling tickets more enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to keep doing this for the foreseeable future, and we weren't sure if we'd be able to handle it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But your story's given me hope. I think we'll manage just fine now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. All I did was give a small taste of my past.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm glad I was able to help.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're here! And ready to practice today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome. So are we.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is Shiho not with you...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, she's on classroom duty today, so she'll be running a little late.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She asked us to get started without her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we get ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You all seem very excited...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I can see why too.
Especially after just hearing what Shiho went through in junior high school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I think we want to show just how much we appreciate her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Back then, I just couldn't give up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd convinced myself that we couldn't really be friends anymore, but deep down, I was hoping that we could.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
As a result, I had to suffer for it.
I was so afraid that I'd end up creating more problems instead of solving them. However...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I endured, and I was rewarded with Ichika and Saki getting our band back together. I'm here today because I didn't give up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I'm really glad that I held on to my music, and more importantly, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, isn't there anything we can do for Shiho outside of our band...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know how you feel. This band isn't about just her anymore. It's about all of us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... What if we do something that she wants us to do? She can ask for one thing from each of us...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, anything...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That could actually complicate things further...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My mom even says, “'Anything is okay' is the most challenging answer...”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We could give her some sort of I.O.U., like kids promising their parents to give them a free massage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that might work...
I could have homemade snacks or a whole lunch for mine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I could totally do her hair for her or something♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. She'd look super cute if I cut her bangs like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shouldn't you be asking how she wants her hair cut...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Those ideas suit you both so well...
What do you think I should do...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shiho's done plenty of nice things for you already, right? Why not return the favor?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's a great idea...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Something nice...
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like when she praised me during practice...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, yours can be called, “All praises all day!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our faces would both be bright red by the end of it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You could take this opportunity to show just how much you appreciate her, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, try saying something now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-Now?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Um...
Miku, the corridor...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shush...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're such a strong girl, Shiho, and the way you're able to clearly say what's on your mind is really cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're always tough on us during practice, but I know that you're even tougher on yourself and work incredibly hard each and every day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really admire how you're dedicating yourself to music like that, and I want to be just like you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, but the way you love cute things is also one of your best qualities!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You always have this gentle expression on your face whenever you're taking care of the bunnies on your phone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that! The bunnies are really cute, but the way you pet them is even cuter!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. A mountain of praise, wouldn't you agree...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: S-Sure...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you might want to leave it there for now. Otherwise, she'll have a hard time joining us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Sh-Shiho...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Why didn't you tell us that you were here...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What kind of person would deliberately walk in on a conversation like that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hang on! Did you make us say those things because you knew she was there...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe? Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: M-Miku please...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask us for anything you need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But for now, I'd like to practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Although, I really wasn't expecting you guys to be talking about me like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But hold on!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We already have everything set up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay! Ready, Miku, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course!
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thanks to Luka's advice, I should be able to write some lyrics that can do their situation justice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Lyrics that can touch Hanano and her brother's hearts...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: She won't be able to get along with her new family as long as her old one's around... Including me...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: In terms of what's best for her future, I feel like she needs to learn to get along with her new family.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Which is why...
Today, I said, “We need to stop meeting like this.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They mean the world to each other but can't tell each other how they really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This isn't quite what we went through, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I know how it feels. I know what it's like to not be able to talk to your friends...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: I told you not to talk to me, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Honami! How about we have lunch together...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...
I kind of want to have lunch alone today...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Alone...?
Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I'm really sorry... Bye...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: H-Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm not bothered by that as much now since we're back as a band and having so much fun every day..)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Back then, I kept asking myself, “How would things have turned out if Saki were here?”)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But Saki was...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: What? Saki caught a cold...?

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Yes. Her fever finally broke yesterday, but it seems to have taken a significant physical and mental toll...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Which is why I'm glad she has a friend here to visit. She should be back from her test soon, so I hope you can cheer her up somehow.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, you're early.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Hi, Saki...!
The nurse told me about how you caught a cold.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I kinda did...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: One of those that makes your sinuses really stuffy too. I guess I caught it from someone, but I couldn't stop sneezing.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
I blew my nose so many times that...
Wait, is it still really red?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: No, you're fine.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Really? Thank goodness...
I was worried that everyone was gonna start calling me a red-nosed reindeer.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki just never changes...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (But I feel like she's pushing herself too hard to keep me from worrying about her...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. My mom brought me some snacks when she visited. Wanna have some?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...
But I need to head back soon.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: (But the nurse said she's tired physically and mentally, so I'd rather she saved her strength.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Okay. That means I get to have all these snacks to myself! Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Well, within reason. You still haven't fully recovered yet.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I know♪

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you later...
Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: I have to transfer at... Okay, I still have time.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wish I could've stayed to chat more with Saki...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: I guess I can listen to some Miku songs instead...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I used to listen to Miku songs a lot whenever I went over to see Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They cover so many genres too.
Just going through them was an easy way to pass the time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I even remember a few times when I passed my stop and nearly missed my transfer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But those Miku songs helped keep the sadness I felt at bay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If we can become their “Miku”...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that sounds too hard...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But at the very least, I want our song to reach them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, time to write!
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm done...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness too... This homework was easier than I initially expected.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, what time is it...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We aren't meeting to practice for a while...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So, I think I'll take this opportunity to go do a quick street performance.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll need my guitar, sheet music and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I left that Miku software I bought on my desk so that I can start using it whenever.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bye, Miku. See you later...
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've gotten pretty used to singing here.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Next, how about I sing...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For my next song, I'd like to sing an original that I wrote with my band.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Look, she's singing for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
This song's nice. Wanna stay and listen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, they're stopping by to listen...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This feels just like when we sang for Hanano and her brother during our show.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It was like my voice could reach everyone in the audience and they'd listen intently.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This must be what it means to have a song reach people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Alright, let's keep this up and...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (There may be others out there who need this song just as much as Hanano and her brother...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That girl's looking my way.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Is she interesting in listening?
If so...)

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: Hey, wanna check out that shop over there next?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Oh... J-Just a second.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's that girl.)

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line:
Um...
I really like the song you just played.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line:
And... Those lyrics...
It reminded me of this friend I used to be really close with in junior high...

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: Oh, the one you said went to a different high school...?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Yeah... We talked and messaged each other a lot up until graduation, but we haven't chatted at all since starting high school.

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: Wait, why not?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: I mean... She's probably made new friends already, so I feel like I'd just end up being a bother...

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I disagree!

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to shout...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But this friend...
She meant a lot to you, right?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Yes. She was the very first friend I made during junior high and we were in the same class all three years...

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: But she ended up going to this really prestigious prep school and seems so far away now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This may sound strange coming from someone you literally just met a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if you still want to talk and hang out with this person, why don't you try contacting them?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right. She might be a high schooler now, but that doesn't mean she's a completely different person.

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: Or is she the kind of person who makes fun of others for not being as smart as her?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: No, she'd never do that...!

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: If that's the case, you're the one who's placing her on a pedestal for getting into a really good school.

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: I think I'll try contacting her.

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Um... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Also, sorry. I know this is my own problem...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one apologizing.
I mean, I sort of just blurted out what was on my mind.

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: It's okay. I'm really glad I got this chance to hear you sing.

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Um... Would you be okay with me stopping by again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... SpoJoy Park's supposed to be near the station... So it should be this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that's also what the map on their website says.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't wait to get there!
I've actually kinda been interested in checking it out for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Really?
I walk by the station sometimes but didn't know about it at all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not supposed to be like a gym or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's more fun than that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(How does Minori do it...?
It's like she, Kanade and Ena are already good friends.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I finally got to meet Kanade again, so I'd like to talk more with her about her group, songwriting and tell her more about the shows we've been doing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They've paused for a bit. Now's my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I get to hang out with an idol today. Mizuki's gonna be so jealous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh...
I missed my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki got all googly-eyed when we got to hang out to Airi and Shizuku that one time too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know that, but I can definitely empathize! I mean, Airi and Shizuku have these amazingly sparkly auras about them!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, didn't you say you've known them since junior high school...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Airi, yes.
She later introduced me to Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry about that.
You probably don't know who I'm talking about, huh, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, um... It's okay...
Actually, they're a year above me at school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, they are, aren't they?
Being idols and all, are they pretty popular at school?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, they are. So popular that everybody lines up to give them presents for their birthdays and such.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow, that's astounding.
Have you ever given them gifts before, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I've known Shizuku since I was little and one of my childhood friends is a big fan of Momoi, so we go greet them together sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. I'm still having a hard time imagining what it'd be like to have idols going to the same school as me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I feel that's pretty normal!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I... I finally got to say something...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I wouldn't have been able to if Ena didn't toss me a question...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also, when I went out to eat with Kanade the other day, I felt like Honami and Asahina had to direct the conversation in order for me to say anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I still can't do much on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we're here, so I can't let things continue like this. I need to take advantage of this opportunity and actually talk to her!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: K-Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... I hope today goes well!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Go well...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, so... In terms of getting in some good exercise!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Yes, I hope so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: G-Great!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also... I really liked that song you were singing earlier.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Would you mind if I asked you to elaborate more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't get to hear all of it, so I can only talk about the parts that I did hear. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The lyrics were very easy to digest and I could feel myself being immersed into your song's world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The melody also had a cool feel to it, which your performance matched very well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The solo version you played was nice, so I'm curious as to what it sounds like when you play it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I couldn't be happier to hear you say that, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... I got to talk to her a little.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I got to hear what she thought of my street performance... That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ichika! Kanade!
I think I see SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Minori and Ena have gone so far ahead...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We must've been walking slower than we realized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You may be right.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope we get to talk more about the things we haven't been able to touch on while exercising at SpoJoy Park.)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Going to SpoJoy Park with everyone was so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never imagined doing anything like that with Kanade, and Ena turned out to be a really nice person.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And we swapped contact info, so I'm looking forward to seeing them again.)
Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi?
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wah!
Oh, Saki, Honami... Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good morning, Ichika.
Whatever you were thinking about seemed to make you really happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, so happy that you didn't notice at all when I was calling your name.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I was just thinking about something I did over the weekend.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something you did?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Minori, Kanade and Ena stopped by to watch the street performance I was putting on down by the station...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade's the person Honami and Asahina introduced me to the other day, and Ena's in the same music group as her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?! Hm? Hang on...
Did Minori already know them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She did. As it turns out, Ena and Momoi are old friends.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I didn't know that.
So they stopped by to listen to your performance together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but only the last part.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori and them were exercising at a nearby park.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she decided to bring them along since the opportunity came up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh?! Wait, Ichika!
Ms. Yoisaki was exercising...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. She decided to try going on a walk in order to increase her stamina so that she can keep composing music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I feel somewhat relieved.
Outside of errands and such, she hardly ever leaves the confines of her home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? I mean, I'm usually out the door if I have free time since I wanna do band practice and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Because that's just who you are, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: However, Honami, if you're surprised by that, you may want to brace yourself before I tell this story.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: M-Ms. Yoisaki went rollerblading, did bubble sumo and played strike zone at SpoJoy Park...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wah! H-Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh no! I-I'm sorry.
I didn't mean to shout...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's totally fine.
I was more surprised by how surprised you were about this person.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, well... I understand that she's doing this for her music, but to think that she did so much in one day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which means she's going to be very sore today. Is there anything I can do for her...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I know! I can try coming up with a dinner menu that includes plenty of protein.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Still, SpoJoy Park...
It's sorta been on my mind too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You have so many exercise options too. It was so much fun that we'd worked up a good sweat before we realized it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Plus, it's good for your health and lets you work on your lung capacity.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, playing a bunch of songs back-to-back can get pretty exhausting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't the four of us go together sometime to work on our stamina?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really wanna go!
Playing bubble sumo like you said sounds super fun, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like to play again as well since it was so much fun. Oh, do you think Shiho would be willing to wear a bubble suit?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The thing that looks like a big, clear balloon?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's not like it's a mascot's costume or anything, so I'm sure she'll wear it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Who's wearing what exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning. I thought I heard some familiar voices...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wh-What is it, Saki...?
The way you're smiling's kinda scaring me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't be scared.
I just wanna ask you to do something, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ask me?
I've got a bad feeling about this, so can we skip it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like you to hear this as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, me too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? That's only making me more suspicious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll show you the pictures we took at SpoJoy Park later, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's also nice to hear that you've gotten to know Ms. Yoisaki better than before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? How can you tell?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Because you're calling her by her first name.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Yes, some things did happen...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, Honami, the light turned green.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Photos are nice and all, Ichika, but I'd like to hear more about what you did at SpoJoy Park.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Of course.
We can talk as we walk.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I must've left without turning the program off... I'm back, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'm not really feeling it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our first show sort of went the same way, but no one responding positively was definitely something new...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did you think of our songs, Saku...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I thought they were cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
You did?!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But they didn't really strike a chord with me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song that resonates with people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe that crowd would've responded better if I'd chosen more relatable language for the lyrics.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No that wasn't the only issue.
I wish I could've helped Saki more with the music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was so happy when you sang for the very first time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry that I can't produce better music for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(When did I fall asleep...?
What time is it...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, a message from Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I'd like for us to do a debrief tomorrow concerning today's show.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Please think of areas where we need improvement, what we can do moving forward and such.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Areas where we need improvement...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Shiho.
I'll make sure to think of some things.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Honami's already replied.
I should do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Sorry about the late reply.
I'll think on this as well.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Stamp
rows.Line: <OK!>

rows.Speaker: Honami's Stamp
rows.Line: <Let's do our best!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Saki hasn't responded yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's usually the first to respond to these kinds of messages too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She might be feeling really down because of what happened during the show and what Saku said...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Sorry! I was doing a solo debrief and totally lost track of the time!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <A solo debrief?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<It's just like how it sounds!
I was doing a debrief all on my own!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Like why we couldn't reach the crowd and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Right. If don't find the answer to that, we'll just end up in the same situation...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, exactly!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <But nothing's made me go, “Eureka!” yet, so I'm gonna keep trying to come up with ideas!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was worried that Saki would've been hit the hardest by what happened today...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But she's so strong.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should also try coming up with some ideas. I need to think about what went wrong and what could've gone better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Thanks, Saki.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Huh? Did I do something worth being thanked for?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <That's a secret.>
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you just got here, but I came up with some lyrics for that song you wrote. Mind taking a look at them for me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, here's what I have...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it fits perfectly with that song!
Nice work, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...
But I have a feeling that it's still missing some pieces.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right... It's hard for me to describe... I can't quite put my finger on it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This song is all about what Saki experienced personally.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm only aware of a small portion of that. Which is why my lyrics aren't really reaching Saki's heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Saki? Did you write any notes when you were writing that song? I'd like to use them as reference if you did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I did! Just gimme a sec...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here it is!
This is the notebook I use when writing songs!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mind if I look at it now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks.
