rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, they're so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm sure our friend's going to like them a lot. Right, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, they look wonderful.
And they smell so nice...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
By the way, what's that you're carrying...? A musical instrument?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, this? It's a guitar.
Actually, the four of us are in a band...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Wait, you are?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
We've been writing our own songs and are putting on a solo show soon!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: That's incredible! Sounds like you're all really enjoying life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much!
We're trying to make the most of our youth!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Most people don't usually say that out loud...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
That's so wonderful.
Flowers are one thing, of course, but I like how music also has these healing properties.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Oh, would it be possible for me to hear some of your songs? I'd love to put them on in the shop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
I-I-I-Ichi! This is a huge advertisement chance for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... We have a channel on this video platform... We put our songs up here.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
So, I can listen to them here?
That's convenient. I should have no problem playing them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that's—!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, you've been carrying our flyers around?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I've been making sure to lately in the hopes that some shops will let us put them up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice thinking.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Way to go, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is a flyer for our solo show. Could we ask you to put it up on display somewhere inside your shop?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd love to.
I can't guarantee how much it'll help, but I'll try finding a place where people will notice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Also, how would you feel about someone my age coming to see your show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course, we'd love to see you there!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Oh, wonderful! I'll be looking forward to it. Hehe. I'll make sure to keep this day free.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do our best♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to do everything we can to give you the best performance possible...!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... The wrapping paper and such should be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Over here.
On these shelves...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, all of these...?
So many to choose from...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure which we should get.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, everyone...
I thought I'd gotten everything we needed, but I completely forgot to buy wrapping supplies...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay since we all forgot about it as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, these look like boxes that you put together yourself... Oh, they even have bags with bows on them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you recommend boxes since they'll probably protect what's inside better?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but you may want to place your candles inside plastic bags first if you do plan on putting them into little boxes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I recommend using bubble wrap and such to ensure that they maintain their shape.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Thank you. I'll try looking for some now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It sounds like Kanade's going with boxes. What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know which to go with either. I can't decide between boxes and bags...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be happy to answer any questions that you have.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami!
The thing is, I sort of have an idea already.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was hoping to keep the wrapping fairly simple so that the person opening it will be surprised by what's inside.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then... How about plain wrapping paper like this one?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, that might work...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
By the way, Mochizuki...
How do you choose wrapping paper in these sorts of situations?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me...? Well...
I usually start by thinking about my gift's recipient.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For example, for Saki, I'd probably choose something cute and fun that uses bright colors.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For Shiho, I'd choose something much cooler and simpler!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... It's sort of the same thing we did when choosing the fragrances for our candles.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mochizuki.
I think I have a better idea of what to get now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I'll try putting your advice into practice. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm glad we were able to get everything we needed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Ms. Yoisaki, you bought quite a few boxes. I sort of feel like you got too many...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me? Oh, um... I bought more than I needed just in case I made a mistake or something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I also bought extras too just in case...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, me too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great minds think alike?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Nene, Kanade & Honami
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope everyone likes what we made...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm already getting nervous...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sure they will.
I mean, you put so much thought into all of them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We all worked incredibly hard on them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!
Valentine's Day
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is it... I'm giving everyone the candles I made today... I really hope they like them...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Oh no! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-It's okay. I'm sorry too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Geez, I know I'm nervous, but I really need to watch where I'm going...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, my candles...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Undamaged. Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Actually, it's probably going to take more than that for them to crack or break... And yet, I can't help but worry...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I saw you checking inside your bag just now. Does that have...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they're the candles I made for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
Thanks to you, Honami, I was able to tie those bows on really nicely... Look!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, they're not in granny knots anymore!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You really surprised me last night when you sent me that message saying, “HELP!” But I'm glad they turned out so well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't have done this without you since all I could tie before were those granny knots...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've placed the candles in plastic bags like Honami said...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And the wrapping varies depending on the receiver, so I'll need to be careful not to mix them up. After that, I just need to tie bows on them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'll start with Saki's...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, that should... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it's a granny knot...
Let me try that again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, huh? That's odd... One more time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hang on. Why does this keep happening...? No, I just have to start over and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, that seems... Still no!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't remember it being so hard to tie bows nicely.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Am I getting mixed up somewhere...?
Let me try... No, I don't know what I'm doing wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You even sent me that video of you trying to tie those bows.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You had this incredibly serious but worried look on your face. So worried that your brow was getting all wrinkled.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, you saw me...?
I thought I sent you a video of what my hands were doing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think your phone fell off its stand towards the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And there was a split second where you appeared... One second...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I look so grouchy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I can tell that you were working very hard on your gift.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'm sure Saki, Shiho, Miku and the others are going to love what you made for them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm pretty nervous, but I'm also looking forward to seeing how they react to these.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.
The day before the show
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tomorrow's finally the day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Our very first solo show...
As nervous as I am...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If it goes well, we'll get a chance to go pro together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's making me even more nervous...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just take...a deep breath...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
I should change out my strings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (There's no rust on them and it feels like a bit of a waste... But I also don't want them to snap on me during our show...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Where are the ones I just bought...?
I thought I put them away with the wire cutters... Oh, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Start by unwinding them one by one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? A message?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hey, I was trying to fall asleep just now but can't because I'm so nervous!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Sleep...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Isn't it a little early to go to bed? It's only eight.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho just wrote something...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Of course you are. It's only eight.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hey, no fair! Don't gang up on me like that!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Seriously? You didn't see this coming?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, these strings actually have a lot of dings and scratches on them. Changing them out was a good idea...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess we have been practicing a lot more than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Oh, Saki. She's sending us so many sad face stamps.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Saki, these notifications and those faces are getting really annoying.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Wahhh!
Ichi, Shiho's bullying me!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <To be fair, this stamp's face does look pretty obnoxious.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <How's that supposed to make me feel better? T_T>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami's writing something now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Saki, it's apparently not good to go to bed so early since your body isn't ready to fall asleep yet.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <So, it's probably best to try to go to bed at your usual time.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Going to bed too early could lead to waking up too early and feeling sleepier sooner than normal?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Yeah, you might not be able to stop yawning before we take the stage.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Oh... I don't want that to happen!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I just need to trim the strings and tune it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, where'd I put my tuner...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Can we talk for a bit since we're all online?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Only a little bit.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm okay with that.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I guess we're having a group call now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hehe. Good evening, everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good evening to you as well.
Honestly, Saki, you sound the furthest thing from sleepy right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Yeah, was this all just some sort of elaborate rouse?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <No, it wasn't! I tried to go to sleep because I finished doing all my homework and had nothing else to do...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Hehe. You finished all your homework, Saki? Good for you.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<*Sob*
Hona, you're the only one who's ever nice to me!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <While we're on the subject, what were you guys doing just now?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I was practicing on my bass.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I was going over what we need to do when after we arrive at the live house tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <The manager and I need to go through a big checklist for our show.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Hona's here to save the day!
What about you, Ichi?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was changing out the strings on my guitar. It seemed like a bit of a waste at first, but they were more dinged up than I initially realized...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really?! Oh, since you've put on some new strings, I wanna hear you play something for us♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure, but I haven't tuned it yet.
It might sound a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Then, can we listen while you tune it?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I hear you tuning your guitar in SEKAI from time to time, but I find it really soothing for some reason.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Yes, I think I know what you mean.
It's such an strange sensation...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <In that case, I'll listen to it as background music while I clean my strings.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? I'm starting to get a little nervous now that I know you're all going to be listening...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <You are? What makes you more nervous? This or tomorrow's show?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... This maybe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really?! That means you're probably gonna play out of your mind tomorrow, Ichi!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <How does that work?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I doubt I'm going to play that well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I feel much better compared to just now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I'll put you on speaker and start tuning my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Okay♪ Then, I'll be thinking of some stuff to say when we talk to the crowd!>
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That student council business took up more time than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're supposed to have our after party with Miku and the others today too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure they're waiting on the rooftop already. I should hurry over and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you doing here, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?! Oh, Ichi, it's you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A-Also, I should be asking you the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I heard that you're gonna be running a little late because of student council stuff, but not this late.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I had a feeling that you'd all be waiting for me. I should've let you all know sooner.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, Ichi, we're not blaming you...!
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A-Anyway, let's head up to the rooftop!
We've got a fun and spectacular after party to attend♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki's acting kind of strange...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, what if...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But remember what Saku said?
“A band's number one goal is to have your music heard by as many people as possible.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something that feels a lot more important comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think getting to play music with all of you matters more to me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I'm kinda worried about how I feel right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I started doubting my commitment when it comes to going pro, and it scared me a little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Are those thoughts still lingering in her mind...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, she has to find the answer to those questions herself...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's something I wanted to tell you after the show, but I didn't get a chance because of how crazy things were.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what do you wanna tell me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: From start to finish, you put on a really amazing performance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really let your feelings of excitement flow while you played...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I believe you ended up enjoying our solo show the most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way you played made me want to do the same thing with my guitar and while I sang. And it felt so good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Saki, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, stop! You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was able to have as much fun as I did because we were all playing together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, the crowd played a huge role by waving their hands for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they really got into it and responded so well to all our shout-outs. Actually, it was probably the best response we've ever received.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Definitely♪ I don't think we've ever been more one with the crowd!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope we get to do another show like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've done it once now, so I'm sure we'll be able to do it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Next time, we might get to play at a venue with an even bigger capacity.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! That'd be so awesome!
It'd be like playing in front of a sea of people! Right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness she's feeling better...)

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Ichika? Saki? Where are you two?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Their voices came from this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
I thought so too...
But the others are already up on the rooftop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! I totally forgot! The others are waiting for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We need to hurry!
Let's go, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Red Brick Center - Building 1, 2nd Floor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's a pretty good disguise. No one's even looking our way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's good to hear. I guess it's thanks to this hat you've picked out for me.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: But coming up with a disguise is kinda hard, huh. If you go overboard hiding your face, it just makes you stand out more because of how suspicious you look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Haruka looks good in everything. Whether it's a hat or some glasses, she just looks fashionable.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Hahaha. But then that becomes a different reason for people to look.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think there's a limit to what Kiritani can wear, though. Even if it is for a disguise...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsk tsk tsk. You're naive, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anything that looks lame on us, Haruka can pull off like a total supermodel!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think you have a little too much faith in me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seems like no one is looking at us while we're here chatting.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Okay then, let's go back to shopping!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what was going to happen after those elementary school kids noticed Kiritani, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (With this, she should be able to have fun without having to worry anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Oh, look over there! That looks like a decor shop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! They're selling stuff from Scandinavia! That's so nice and chic!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds interesting. Let's go have a look.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Look at this table! The wood is so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: These Scandinavian products have this really nice natural aesthetic to them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They do. I'm sure putting some of these in a room would give it a calming effect.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I like the sound of that! Even just one or two cushions could totally make a vibe!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
Oh, the cushions are over that way.
I was thinking about taking a look. Did you want to come with?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Really? Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll keep having a look at the lifestyle section here for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I will too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Hope you find something good♪

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Thanks! Alright, we'll see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, there's a catalog of the furniture over there. Want to have a look?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, this room only has a bed, a table and a dresser, and yet it looks so nice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. I wonder if it's because it doesn't look too lived-in...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, check this out! Is it just me or does the placement of the furniture kinda look similar to my room?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right. The layout and the way they've put photos on the wall does look similar.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Does it have the same feel too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd say Saki's room is the total opposite. It has a much cuter look to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What she said♪ I have a cute and colorful floor rug and decorated the room with stars♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, a cute look, huh. I think I can picture that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's your room like, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My room? Nothing special, you know? I have a desk and my bed against the wall and a table in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And...two windows.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, my room also has two windows. It's nice getting a lot of sunlight and having the wind come in during the summer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh! Hey Haruka, tell us more about your room♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have my bed near the window and next to that is my desk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also... I have some wall shelves above my desk, and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing, but I have penguin items around the room too. They're a combination of plushies I bought myself and ones given to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh right, you love penguins. So that means it's a pretty cute room, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I guess if I had to say so, then yes...
But I also made space for my workout equipment, which doesn't quite fit the whole atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Workout equipment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like dumbbells and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I also have a push-up bar for when I do push-ups and a roller for ab workouts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's amazing! I know that you go running and maintain a diet, but I didn't know you also do strength training!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. Although, these days I mainly do it to keep my body in shape.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be honest, I actually want to collect more penguin goods and make my own little south pole...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: South pole?! Wouldn't you catch a cold?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you assume that she'll turn down the temperature too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, what? I'm confused...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But a room filled with all of your favorite things sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe you should decorate your room with yakisoba bun cushions and stuff, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmmm... That would be nice, but I think I'd be happier with Miku merch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha, true♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, would you mind telling me more about your rooms?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! I want to hear more about your room too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Looks like Inoue and Sonoda will be a while, so we can keep chatting for a bit.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! Morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The field trip was so much fun!
I was talking to my mom about Yokohama the whole night after I got home♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did the same thing when I gave my parents their souvenirs. I told them about how I went on the water taxi with Kiritani and all that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Time out, Ichi! You're supposed to call her by her first name!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...that's right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so used to calling her by her last name that it's a bit hard to just switch—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning, Kiritani—oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Whistle*
You called her by her last name again! You get a yellow card, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Grimace*
That's what I was saying before. It's just reflex...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if we agreed to switch, it does take some time to get used to it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But still, it does make me happy to call each other by our first names... I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm. If it's just about getting used to it, then why don't we play a game to help with that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? A game?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Before speaking, you first say the other person's name, and then the person who is spoken to will say your name after they reply.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you're not allowed to slip up or forget to call them by their first name♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounds interesting. Okay, I guess it'd go something like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika, the field trip was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, uh...yes. I was just talking to Saki about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, her name! Don't forget her name!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Oh...Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There we go! That's the spirit!
Alright, now you try starting Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haruka... The weather's really nice today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika, have you given your family their souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Mom and Dad really liked them. It was worth spending all of that time picking them out with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Saki, you said that you couldn't stop talking about Yokohama with your mom yesterday, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm! From when we were on the way to after we got there, I told her about everything♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had so much to say that she ended up listening and chatting with me even after dinner, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even Saki is sticking to the rules...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haruka, what about you?
Did you talk to your family about the trip?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I did. And when I gave them the souvenir sailor penguin chocolates we saw after we got off the water taxi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My mom said that she had actually seen them before when she went to Yokohama with her friends a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? So that means they must be pretty popular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She also said that she's been friends with them ever since.
So, this is a bit of a strange segue, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here, I'd like you two to have some.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow!!! Does that mean if we eat these, our friendship will be forever lasting?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not like they actually ate these, so this is just a token of sorts...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even so, that makes me happy. I also want to be closer friends with you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should get to our seats. See you—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh! Wait, Haruka! You too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you two like to eat lunch together, the three of us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like that. Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm! Let's have lunch together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, thanks for suggesting that game. I think I've gotten the hang of calling Haruka by her first name now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're very welcome♪
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Phew!
We're sounding really good together for every song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. All that's left is for us to get to where we can play without taking any breaks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've got this! We have way more stamina now thanks to our solo show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Hona worked so hard that she's super buff now♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, look at my big biceps! Well, not really...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does this mean you agree with her, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It is true that I'm much stronger now because of our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I feel more confident now after being able to play the way I wanted until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you haven't been hesitating at all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, if we can keep this up, our show's gonna be a huge success♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And after it's done, we're gonna go see the Peperoncino... I mean, the Perseid meteor shower together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You got it right this time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I didn't hear what you said clearly that time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, we should probably get a few things ready for the meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Get things ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how we took cushions over when we went stargazing in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought it'd be nice to have some things that allow us to lie back as we watch like we did then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we won't be doing our necks any favors if we have to look up for long periods...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're gonna go to that park with the jungle gym, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we're gonna be there, I wanna watch from the top of it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The jungle gym...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: What's the matter, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Just making a wish that we could stay like this forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Playing together, talking about stuff, watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I want to watch from that jungle gym too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, we won't need a tarp or anything.
What else do we need...? Oh, probably some bug spray.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... But isn't that about all we really need?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on!
What about snacks and drinks?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But we're meeting at night.
I'm sure we'll all have eaten dinner already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, we're really not gonna bring any?! Don't you wanna have a nighttime picnic?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but we might miss some of the shooting stars while we're focused on eating and drinking.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if we get hungry...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...
Bring whatever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
If we happen to be alone, why don't we try inviting Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
But they're probably pretty used to seeing pretty skies...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They need to see how pretty our sky can be♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we can ask them when we go over to practice next time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get back to practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to play the songs between our talk portions like it's the real deal.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Looks like we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
And the sky's super clear. This means...

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line: Look! A shooting star!

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Wait, there's another one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's already starting...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's hurry over to the park.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's no one else here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're right.
I thought there was gonna be a ton of people here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, a bunch of people at those condos over there are out watching from their balconies. Everyone might be staying home for this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
That must be nice, like having your own VIP section.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Aren't you forgetting about our VIP section?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, let's climb up the jungle gym♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, need me to push you up like when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I can climb up all by myself now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm up.
That was definitely easier than back then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because we're big girls now♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's great and all...
But it feels pretty cramped up here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It does...
Here, I'll move more towards the middle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I haven't seen a single shooting star since that last one...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me neither, but let's try to be patient.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, then, let's switch seats!
We can sit where we all did way back when we saw the Leonid meteor shower!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, you were at the very top!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Saki, Honami, you two were next to me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Shiho sat one rung below, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You all remember?
So... Oh, I think I was sitting here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, you switch with me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Watch your step, okay?
If it feels like you're going to fall, it might be better to climb down and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll be fine♪ You're already in the middle, so lemme borrow your hand for a second!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here. You be careful too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I will. Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! A perfect recreation♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Just like old times...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I just saw a shooting star...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Where?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Near that building to the right—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I just saw one over that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Where?! Show me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We should call Miku and the others over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku? Can you all hear us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, loud and clear.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thanks for inviting us.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<How's the meteor shower?
Have you seen any shooting stars yet?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we're just starting to see more and... Oh, look! There!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line:
A shooting star!
<A shooting star!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, there's another! Whoa! And another one over there?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow... It's nonstop now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They really are showering across...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <This park is where you all came when you were little, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we climbed on top of this jungle gym to watch the Leonid meteor shower.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That really takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki made a wish that time hoping we'd be together forever.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And now, here you are...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because of you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really doubt we alone would've been able to make her wish come true.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. What if the shooting stars you saw that time were the reason why her wish came true?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You saw a meteor shower that time, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If those shooting stars did make that wish come true, I feel like they gave us too much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Too much?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because we even got to meet you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. True.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're just glad that those feelings belonged to such wonderful people.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi, Miku!
Let's see who can spot the most shooting stars!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ready to lose, Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I could ask you the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
<Hehe.>
One week before Ichika's birthday
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, everyone, thank you for watching us practice again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't mention it. This makes for good practice for us as well. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, see you then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, isn't it Ichika's birthday soon?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's next week.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next week?! Happy birthday, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a little early for that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you. I'll stop by on the day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's sweet of you. But don't you have plans to celebrate in your world too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's your special day, so it's fine to spend it relaxing with friends and family.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. But... I want to see you all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, we'll get ready to celebrate with you here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, how are you gonna celebrate? Are you gonna go out somewhere as a group?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I'm planning to have a study session with my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? You're studying on your birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were actually already talking about having a study session♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, once we started sounding out interest, we ended up with more participants than we expected.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When we compared everyone's schedules to find a day that worked, we noticed one of the days was Ichika's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So we figured, with that many people able to come, why not combine a party with the study session?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice idea. Study sessions are a classic part of high school life.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm excited since it's rare to gather this many people for one study session.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Excitement is important, but don't forget you're there to study.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. I'm going to study hard to earn my party afterward.
Ichika's birthday
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahem, greetings, gathered friends!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you very much for gathering for today's “Study Session Followed By Ichika's Birthday Party”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoo♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On this table, you will find snacks and juice earmarked for the study session. Please help yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: However! Everything on this table over here is off-limits! And who can tell me why?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because those are for the birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ding ding ding!
By the way, there will also be cake at the party, so take care not to fill up on snacks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's really getting into this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She is. When I went with her to help buy stuff, she chose the snacks really carefully.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So that means these are the snacks that made the cut☆ I can't wait to try them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't forget that we're here to study.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And now, before we begin our study session, let's hear a few words from the star of the day, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? No one told me about this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can do it, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Go, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hurry up, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Thank you all for coming despite your busy schedules.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Originally, we just thought that it would be better to study as a group instead of alone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But so many people showed interest that we had the idea to turn it into a fun event.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, uh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There'll be a party when we're done, so for now, let's study hard!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Emu & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Who's working on English? Want to team up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyone on Classics?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Over here. Let's work together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What about math? Who'll buddy up with me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Meee!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, me too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're also working on math, Kusanagi? Come sit with us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Honami, can you help me?
I need to put words in the right order for this question. “Make” is acting as a causative verb here, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
So, all you need to do now is find the grammatically correct word order...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Groan*
I don't get this. I'm looking at the modern translation and I still don't understand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which line? Wait, I don't think you have the right place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But, isn't this the translation of that confusing “okashi” word?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The translation for that line is the one before. It's a little easy to get lost since the two lines have similar phrasing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Shiho, Haruka, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel like I'm really on top of my game today! Maybe it's because we're studying together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm also solving these problems really quickly♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also get the feeling that I'm more focused than usual.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I guess it really is nice to study together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh, I have an idea! Let's race to solve ten problems!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone who correctly solves ten problems will get to eat from this bag of limited-edition chocolate-smothered potato chips!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm using a different workbook than you guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're all practicing quadratic functions, so I rule that you qualify!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whooo♪ We can do this, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's all solve them faster than Saki and eat all her chips.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh... As if I'd let that happen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, on your marks, get set...

rows.Speaker: Nene, Ichika & Emu
rows.Line:
Go!
Go☆
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what...?
For this one, I should...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Done♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What, already?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
G-Get your answers checked!
Ask someone to look at them, and you have to redo any problems that you got wrong!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okie dokie☆
Hey, Honami, Kohane, are you free?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, now's my chance to make progress!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She really wants those chips...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, we need to match that passion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Done!
Hona, Kohane! Check mine too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki's finished too. Kusanagi, how many problems do you have left?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just one... What about you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Same here. We're nearly there, so let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Woohoo! All correct!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?! I got two of them wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good work, everyone. That's it for our study session!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nice work, everybody.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Tough luck, Saki.
You would've come second had it not been for those miscalculations.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Wail*
Ichi and Nene overtook me while I was redoing them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Tenma? I saved some potato chips for you, so don't panic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Nene, you're some goddess of mercy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And next up is what you've all been waiting for! Ichi's birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She cheered up quickly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! All hands, help out with the cake☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, we don't need that many people for the cake.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'll go get the cake ready.
Can I leave you to deal with the rest?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... What should I—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ichika, come here!
Just stand in this spot and wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...? Here in the middle of the room?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's right.
Oh, here it comes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What's this big box? Is there a cake inside...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You'll have to wait and see! Here we go, lights out♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-What's happening?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, start the countdown!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Roger! T-minus five!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Four!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Three!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Two!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line: One!
Zero!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: This cake is for you. Please blow out the candles.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here I go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you, Ichika Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! All these petals are so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't believe even you're here, Robo-Nene. Thank you for coming to celebrate with me.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You are welcome. Thank you for being friends with Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hey, knock that off...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, it's me that should be saying thanks for that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going to cut the cake. Everyone, please get ready for the toast.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Minori & Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (After such a fun study session, it feels like I'm getting to have two whole parties.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, what do you want to drink?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... I'll have an orange juice!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! Did you have fun at your study session and party? You only get one birthday a year, so make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hoshino. I don't know if this counts as a gift, but... I wrote up a simplified overview of how to use some equipment that I haven't shown you yet. Feel free to use it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hoshino. Also, kudos for your hard work at that study session. You must be terribly busy with your band and your schoolwork, but I'll gladly help you with studying if you ever need a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika. I'm happy to hear you had fun on your birthday with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We made lots of progress on our homework and got to eat snacks and even cake. It was just as fun a day for us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I've been busy lately and it's been hard to make time to hang out with people, but I'm glad I made it to your party.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika, we hope you had a wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! I'd never been to such a big study session before, and I'm so glad you invited me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you're interested, let's do a street performance sometime. See you at school!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ichika! Happy birthday☆ I'm really glad we got to have so much fun on your special day! Let's go out somewhere sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Going out? Yeah, that'd be nice. We've been shopping together before, but we could all go to a zoo or an aquarium.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will provide information on wildlife when that time comes! Please look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! With you around, I have nothing to fear for Saki! Please continue to look after her along with Shiho and Honami!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, Tsukasa... It's not like Ichi and the others are only ever helping me out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, we're pros now! So we gotta give it everything we got moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. Let's keep doing all we can to share our music with more and more people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! When the four of us work together, there's nothing we can't overcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, I'm counting on you as always. Have the most wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many people gave me birthday wishes today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It reminded me that I'm not alone, and I'm surrounded by so many people I can depend on. I feel braver already.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm a professional now, so I need to be my own person and keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I feel like I'm ready for a brand new start.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for all your birthday wishes today. I hope you keep supporting me.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Phew... Thank goodness I managed to get to the school store before it got too crowded.)
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Welcome back, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Honami? Oh, Kohane, you're here too.
Were you two waiting for me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. We thought it'd be nice to have lunch together now that we're in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, since it's so nice out, why don't we have lunch in the courtyard...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Kohane
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel that the three of us have never really had lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But we'll probably be doing this a lot more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really looking forward to getting to know you two better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
Ichika, are you having yakisoba buns for lunch again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I just can't get enough of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see you eating them all the time.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really surprised the first time I saw you have one as an entree and one on the side...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you were...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm used to it now, but that also surprised me the first time I saw you doing it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, it's not good to only have those. You really should try to get a better mix of meats and vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm also a little worried.
Would you like some of my broccoli?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here, I'll share some of my tomatoes with you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, is it that weird to have yakisoba buns without anything else on the side...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haruka sort of said the same thing when I had lunch with her for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino, are you only having yakisoba buns for lunch?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She basically had the same reaction as you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I was a little surprised.
But I don't think it's weird or anything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
I mean, there's nothing wrong with having what you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Honami, you sort of do the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember when you went out to buy apple pies the other day? Didn't you say that you bought twenty and ate all of them by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, twenty...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, it's not like I had them all in one day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I can't do that with any type of food. Apple pies just happen to have a special place in my heart...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, twenty's pretty astounding...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... All this talk of yakisoba buns and apple pies is making my stomach feel full for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too... I've hardly touched my lunch, but I feel like I've already had a full meal.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can still eat... More to the point, I'm going to eat these. They're yakisoba buns, after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd probably say the same thing if I were having apple pies for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess we all love what we love.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You two are here early.
What were you talking about just now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were just talking about the committees since the teacher said we'd be choosing which to join during our next homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that did come up...
I'd completely forgotten...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you know which committee you want to be on, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I hadn't given it any thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was a class representative last year, so I might want to try something different this year...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I sort of don't remember what all the other committees are.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well...
There's the health committee, library committee...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Plus, the planning committees for the School Festival and the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
What else is there...? The broadcasting committee...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The broadcasting committee...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure what they actually do, but that committee's in charge of playing music during lunch, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I always look forward to hearing what songs they choose to play since they pull from such a wide range of genres.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too... But how do they actually choose? Do they just play songs that the teachers recommend or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, one of my friends was on that committee and she said one time that they get to choose which songs to play.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They do...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, the teachers have to check over their choices in the end, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Most songs seem okay as long as they don't cause any problems for the school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which means you get to recommend the songs you like to everyone in school by playing them over the speakers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'd get to play the music I like...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But which songs?
Miku ones...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (There's a whole list of those that I'd want to recommend to everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you thinking about playing Miku songs throughout the school, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh?!
I, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is that true?
All the songs you recommend are really good, so the broadcasting committee might be a perfect fit for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I am a little interested in joining...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But they don't just play music over the speakers. They're also the ones who work as announcers during the Sports Festival, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. They also do things like mock radio programs during lunch sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just playing songs would be fine, but I'm less sure about having everyone in school hear me talk. That makes me a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? It does?
But you do a great job of talking to the audience during your shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's something I finally figured out how to do recently. I was so nervous the first time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't that all the more reason to join the committee...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You figured out what to do during your shows, so I'm sure you'll do great as a member of the broadcasting committee!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you don't have to join if you really don't want to, Ichika. Nobody's forcing you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, if you are interested, I think you should give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Both of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It would be fun to play Miku songs over the speakers... And I really want more people to know about them. This could be worth it...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Yes, I'm nervous about my voice being heard...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we'll be making our professional debut soon. I shouldn't be afraid of speaking in public.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It might even help me talk to the audience better during our shows...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're both right.
I'll try joining.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We know you'll do great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good luck, Ichika!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait for classes to start!
I'm all read up on everything we're about to learn♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish I could be as excited about classes as you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Ichi, are you not looking forward to them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I am looking forward to some subjects...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I think I'm more worried than excited since other subjects like math will probably be harder than last year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Having to learn harder formulas and stuff does make me kinda shudder.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there's nothing wrong with not immediately understanding new stuff. We can always ask the teachers or Hona for help if we have any questions!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki always shows so much strength whenever we start something new.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My mind can't help but jump towards things going wrong... But Saki wants to take on new challenges.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We'll probably be faced with more than a few after we make our debut as professional musicians.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to be able to think like Saki when that happens.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
Let's do our best today, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Wait, huh...?
We're in different classes this year. Why are we in front of the same one...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki!
This is 1-C!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
N-No, you're right...!
I was about to walk into a first-year classroom again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Argh! We're second-years now!
We need to start acting more like it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-Saki, wait.
I know how you feel, but you're going to startle everyone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Or are we too late...?)

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: Hey, aren't they second-years?

rows.Speaker: First-Year B
rows.Line: They came to the wrong classroom by accident. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, they don't seem to mind...
I guess we're in the clear...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, we need to hurry over to our actual classrooms or we're going to be late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Right!
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...and we had to get over here in a hurry.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That explains why you were a little late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can see how you two ended up at the wrong classroom. I mean, until not too long ago, that's what was normal to us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What was normal...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Emu and I greeted each other just now, but going to different classrooms felt a little odd...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know what you mean. I feel the same way whenever I see my old classmates walking towards different classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess we're all still trying to get used to our new class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope we get settled in soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I haven't really talked to some of our classmates before, so it'd be nice to become friends with them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (In time, the three of us talking like this might start feeling completely normal.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't know what this upcoming year has in store for us, but I hope I'll be able to make a lot of good memories.)
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Before we start our practice, I want to go over the stuff that came up during practice yesterday and some other things for us all to keep in mind. Let me know once you guys are all set up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That means I get to use the notebook I got for band practices right away.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, you got a new notebook...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My old one only had a few pages left, so I decided to get a new one while I was out shopping for school notebooks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Cool.
It's like you're getting a fresh new start!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was also sorting through all of my old notebooks and realized that I have a big pile of them for lyrics and practices now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Which raised a question.
How long do I keep them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Dunno...
Everyone takes notes in different ways.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My notes from when we just got our band back together are all about the basics, which probably won't help us now... Maybe I should get rid of them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What, like throw them out?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm holding onto mine forever♪
They're basically the same as old diaries!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, since we have been practicing just about every day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, after we've debuted as pros, you could present them on TV as a piece of our past♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you're getting a little ahead of yourself there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? There's also all the audio we recorded of us practicing. I'm starting to wonder what we should do about that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Right, I haven't been deleting those. I'll probably run out of space soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get videos, but I didn't realize how much space sound files could take up! Still, I wanna keep as many as I can...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You could move them somewhere else.
I've heard of services that provide backup data storage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I might have to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What about you, Shiho?
Do you save all your notebooks and recordings and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I keep my notebooks.
They remind me to not forget about my roots.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I usually delete audio files when I feel that we've become good enough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is it that surprising?
They keep piling up basically every day, so I need to do something about them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like you not to stress over that sort of thing, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, then! Hona, what about you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I still have all of my notebooks too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As far as audio recordings go, I try to keep the most memorable ones, like of our rehearsals the day before shows and such.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes sense...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks for taking the time to discuss this.
In that case, I'll hang onto my notebooks for a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But that leaves the sound files...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I dunno what to do either. I mean, there's something special about how we play in the heat of the moment that makes each performance unique.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, I say just leave them.
If you delete them and end up regretting it down the road, it'll be too late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't really play the way we used to because of how much we've improved.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She's right.
We sound like a completely different band compared to when we first got back together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we first got back together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, I think I'll keep our very first recording alongside our best ones.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whenever I'm feeling down, I can cheer myself up by taking a listen, looking back and seeing just how far we've come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll save all of our recordings on behalf of our band!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can even turn it into a quiz down the road! Question! What song were we practicing in this recording, and around when was it taken?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're joking, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds like fun, but I'm not sure if I'll get the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, are you all ready?
We still need to talk about the stuff that came up yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Line: <Oh, the one you had “me” sing...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki and the others said that it was really good, so I was hoping to sing it as a Leo/need song for real.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wonderful. I've been meaning to ask you more about that song.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But if you haven't made much progress, then...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't clearly recall how the melody went or what the lyrics were. I'm only able to remember bits and pieces...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Can you play for me what you have been able to remember? I'd also like to see the lyrics if possible...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure, I'll play the melody now.
And the lyrics are here in this notebook.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is a part of the chorus...
But it's pretty hard to tell what the song is about, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I don't think so.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I sensed your kindness very clearly, Ichika. You were trying to show your support for Saki and the others.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The lyrics also made me want to keep my chin up and move forward.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But the melody and lyrics still feel really incomplete. This song is different from the one I had the others listen to in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why can't I remember how it went? I can clearly recall everything else that happened.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Do you remember what you felt as you wrote this song...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, actually...
I remember the theme being a song of support that would cheer them up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... What if you can't remember because of that massive sense of relief you felt after getting your message across to them?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that might be why.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After they said that it was good, I felt this incredible sense of accomplishment or fulfillment.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we began talking about performing as a band at the school festival, watched the Leonid meteor shower together and finally got our memories back...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Considering how quickly things moved at the end there, I think it's only natural that you don't remember how your song went.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I tried thinking about the emotions I felt, and even tried to revive them. But nothing's worked so far.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You really can't do anything about that.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because the you from that dream and the real you are one and the same, but also not.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I mean, when writing a song, an individual's experiences and knowledge can greatly influence what they end up producing, no?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Compared to my current self, the me in that dream led a drastically different life.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Exactly...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Only the you from that dream was capable of producing that song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that dream, not only was I terrible at playing the guitar, that was the first song I'd ever written. I was really just wandering around in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If I were to hear that song right now, I might feel embarrassed because of how bad I was at everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I managed to reach the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which sort of makes me believe that it may be better for you not to remember how it went.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You could all lock it away in your hearts as the fabled song that brought you back together.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Fabled...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Trying to recreate it based on just bits and pieces of information wouldn't be very fair to the me from that dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Instead, I should be writing songs that I can produce as I am now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree with that statement.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll be looking forward to hearing your new song. I'd like to sing it if possible.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course! All of us can sing it, together!
Photo Shoot

rows.Speaker: Photographer
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good!
Alright, let's try this angle next...

rows.Speaker: Photographer
rows.Line:
Okay, that's perfect!
For your first time doing a cover shoot, you know how to work!

rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Line:
We'll resume in fifteen.
Next, we'll be taking shots of you individually.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That photographer praised us so much♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't go relaxing just yet. We still have to take our solo shots.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Solo shots...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Honami?
