rows.Line: Um... I'm a little anxious about having to be all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: During our last photo shoot, I ended up taking a really long time during the solo portion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know how you feel! Every time we do solo shoots they tell me my face ends up looking weird.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's hard not to be nervous.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, but Ichika, your shoots always go fairly smoothly. Is it because you're used to being on camera?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's probably the most used to it out of all of us, I guess. A lot of magazines until now have asked for solo shoots with just the vocalist.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's true I've done mostly solo shoots...
But aren't you probably more used to having your picture taken, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I take a lot of pics on my phone, but this is totally different!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I always start thinking about how I have to be sure I look cool and stuff, which makes me freeze up!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. The photographers tell us to just act natural, but that's easier said than done.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So basically, it boils down to just relaxing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which makes what you do all the more amazing, Ichi! What's your secret? How do you always do it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I really don't do anything special...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but I have recently been making an effort to think about fun things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fun things?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. They told me that might help me relax at another photo shoot a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For example, I'll think about all the times we've had lunch together at school. I've also thought about my favorite Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. That does seem like a good way to calm yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I think I'm getting it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In my case, I can try remembering all the times we hung out together! We always have so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I might try thinking about my walks with Shibao. What about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me? Well...
I found a good song the other day, so I could just try playing it in my head...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh! That sounds like the perfect solution for you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope all your ideas work.
A few hours later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
Our shoot ended up going very well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The photographer said that they were able to get a lot of good pictures. I can't wait to see how everything turns out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even our solo shoots ended up going well thanks to you, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I am glad that I was able to help you all.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: So I was remembering eating them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. That's great, Ichi!

rows.Line: So that beautiful smile was all thanks to yakisoba buns.

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Now I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed...

rows.Line: (That was so much fun...)

rows.Line: (The entire venue overflowed with everyone's love of Miku. And she answered back accordingly.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm also really glad that Honami got to enjoy herself.)

<Ichika.>

rows.Line: <From your expression, it must've been very good.>

rows.Line: <Hehe. Can you tell me more?>

rows.Line: Alright, where should I start...

rows.Line: And I think this was from the encore.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Look at all the glow sticks. They're beautiful.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
Being able to see the singer's expressions as they sing is one of the best parts of a live show.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And then, Miku said we should all sing the next song together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We sang while looking at the lyrics on the monitors. That was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wow, with all these people...?
I would've loved to hear what that was like.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They sometimes upload videos of these concerts, so I'll show you if they do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But it might really surprise you.
Everyone's love for Miku was so loud that I could barely even hear her.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's when the medley started, like a sprint to the finish line.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's a nice idea. Medleys let you listen to a variety of songs, and the way they flow together gives the performance momentum.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. I was so excited that I ended up waving my arms around a ton. I'm probably going to be really sore tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's proof that you thoroughly enjoyed yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It was a fun concert from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, it reminded me of how amazing Miku and the others are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What do you mean?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: During the show, and even after it was over, all the people in the audience around me were smiling...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also saw people who were complete strangers discussing how incredible everything was.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's amazing how Miku and the others can bring people together like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also want us to put on shows like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It might be difficult for me right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I want Leo/need's shows to bring people together through our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I plan on doing everything I can for that. For our upcoming solo show too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sure you and the others will succeed, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And we promise to give you girls all the support we can so you're able to put on the best show ever.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to keep practicing. I have to become a better guitarist and singer.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So that we're able to put on the best performance we can during our solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So that the audience goes home believing that they just saw something truly incredible!)
Ichika's birthday
School SEKAI

rows.Line: Thank you all very, very much for gathering here today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And nowー
I'd like to begin the earliest celebration of Ichi's birthday in the whole, wide world!
Clap clap clap♪

rows.Line:
Anyway, Miku, you have the honors!
Take it away for us♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Are we all ready?

rows.Line: Then... Ichika, let's have as much fun as we can tonight until you start getting sleepy. Happy birthday!

rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really happy that we've been able to reach so many people through our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it hasn't been all fun and games. We've also seen how we still have a lot of work left ahead of us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'd like to become a better guitarist, songwriter, performer, everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

I think we'll hit the hay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay, good night.
The girls are safe in our hands.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You and the others also seem very sleepy, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm having trouble keeping my eyes open...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too... Down I go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saki, you're really heavy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shiho's already half-asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But watching those Miku concerts, singing and doing cheers together was really fun.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we call it a night and go to bed?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll wake you up later, so there's no need to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to thank everyone again later for throwing such a fun birthday party for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And staying up so late with me like this.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, good night.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's nice to start off another year of life with a birthday like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
I messaged you pretty late last night, so I was surprised when you replied right away.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I heard that you all had a sleepover and watched Miku concerts together. I have to think that watching them with you must've been really fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
I wish I'd sent you a message too, since I was actually awake at the time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
I heard that you didn't get much sleep last night. Make sure to get plenty of rest tonight, okay? And don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
I'm glad to hear that the sleepover you had last night ended up being really fun! I'd love to hear your recommendations for Miku concerts sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Miku plushie I picked is so wonderhoy! It's Miku in a hero-style outfit making a fashionably late entrance! She'll always be on your side no matter what happens, Ichika☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
Wait, you look really sleepy. Your eyes are barely open...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii, her and the others apparently had a birthday sleepover last night. It sounded like they stayed up very late, so I think that explains that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well now, that sounds like a lot of fun. It really feels like youth too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, why don't we as MORE MORE JUMP! give her a boost of energy by celebrating?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's give it a go. We'll have to really put our hearts into it since she's on the other side of the screen. Ready? Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
Did you and the others... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika!!! Happy birthday!!! I, Tsukasa Tenma, shall take the lead in ensuring that this upcoming year goes splendidlyー Wait, Nene, don't run off with the camera! Come back here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Talk about being obnoxious... Anyway, happy birthday. I hope your music reaches the hearts of lots and lots of people, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yawn... Wow, that sleepover was so much fun!
I had a blast watching all those Miku concerts with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I actually began tearing up a little since Miku was the one who brought us all back together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You, Saki and Ichika were all crying during that last concert. To be fair, it hit me pretty hard too, with everything to think about...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to keep striving towards producing music like that, the kind that really leaves an impression on people. Again, Ichika, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for all the birthday wishes, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Staying up late in SEKAI was so much fun. And spending time with all of my favorite people made it a wonderful memory.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can make a precious memory with Miku by watching one of her concerts by yourself, or make a special memory with someone else by watching it with them. Being able to connect with others through music is just so nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to keep doing our best so that we're able to produce that kind of music for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you all for always being so great.
And we look forward to your continued support.
